delivery.outcome: Portable Skills errors and composition rules keep bootstrap validation non-terminal until exact ordered follow-ups are independently authorized and read back.
nonGoals: Execute Subactor agents or mutate adopter configuration
Define an HTTP, queue or signature implementation
Issue authority or let bootstrap authority cover later mutations
Invent repository content, test commands, credentials, licenses or destructive recovery

architecture.decision: Extend the existing execution-error companion standard and adoption guidance; leave receipt transport and follow-up execution in runtime adopters.
interfaceChanges: Add canonical validation-transport, follow-up and profile-readiness execution errors
dataChanges: Require the additive error codes during execution-registry conformance
architecture.rollback: Remove the additive error records, required-code check and bootstrap composition guidance; runtime adopters remain fail-closed on unknown errors.
